content.description: Illustration showing thermostat location in engine cooling system near water outlet housing

items:
REMOVE WATER OUTLET
Remove the three bolts and the water outlet from the water outlet housing.

content.text: The thermostat is numbered according to the valve opening temperature.

content.description: Illustration showing thermostat being heated in water on stove/heating element for testing

content.text: (a) Immerse the thermostat in water and heat the water gradually.

content.description: Cross-section diagram of thermostat showing internal valve mechanism and measurement point for valve lift

content.text: (b) Check the valve opening temperature and valve lift. If the valve opening temperature and valve lift are not within the following specifications, replace the thermostat.

Valve lift:
More than 8 mm (0.31 in.) at 100°C (212°F)
(c) Check that valve spring is tight when the thermostat is fully closed. Replace if necessary.

content.description: Diagram showing thermostat installation orientation with jiggle valve and printed side of gasket positioning

items:
PLACE THERMOSTAT IN WATER OUTLET HOUSING
Install the thermostat with the jiggle valve upward.

INSTALL WATER OUTLET
Install the water outlet, facing the printed side of gasket forward.
START ENGINE AND CHECK FOR LEAKS
